catalog-v-accounting: SELECT COUNT(*) AS CLIENTS,SUM(CASE WHEN ABS(C.SALDO-COALESCE(M.AMOUNT,0)-COALESCE(D.AMOUNT,0))>0.01 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DIFFERENCES,MAX(ABS(C.SALDO-COALESCE(M.AMOUNT,0)-COALESCE(D.AMOUNT,0))) AS MAX_DIFFERENCE FROM CLIE15 C LEFT JOIN (SELECT CVE_CLIE,SUM(IMPORTE*SIGNO) AS AMOUNT FROM CUEN_M15 GROUP BY CVE_CLIE) M ON M.CVE_CLIE=C.CLAVE LEFT JOIN (SELECT CVE_CLIE,SUM(IMPORTE*SIGNO) AS AMOUNT FROM CUEN_DET15 GROUP BY CVE_CLIE) D ON D.CVE_CLIE=C.CLAVE
differences: SELECT C.CLAVE,C.NOMBRE,C.SALDO,COALESCE(M.AMOUNT,0)+COALESCE(D.AMOUNT,0) AS ACCOUNTING FROM CLIE15 C LEFT JOIN (SELECT CVE_CLIE,SUM(IMPORTE*SIGNO) AS AMOUNT FROM CUEN_M15 GROUP BY CVE_CLIE) M ON M.CVE_CLIE=C.CLAVE LEFT JOIN (SELECT CVE_CLIE,SUM(IMPORTE*SIGNO) AS AMOUNT FROM CUEN_DET15 GROUP BY CVE_CLIE) D ON D.CVE_CLIE=C.CLAVE WHERE ABS(C.SALDO-COALESCE(M.AMOUNT,0)-COALESCE(D.AMOUNT,0))>0.01
partial-payments: SELECT FIRST 5 M.CVE_CLIE,M.NO_FACTURA,M.IMPORTE,M.IMPORTE+SUM(D.IMPORTE*D.SIGNO) AS REMAINING FROM CUEN_M15 M JOIN CUEN_DET15 D ON D.CVE_CLIE=M.CVE_CLIE AND D.REFER=M.REFER AND D.NUM_CARGO=M.NUM_CARGO WHERE M.SIGNO=1 GROUP BY M.CVE_CLIE,M.NO_FACTURA,M.IMPORTE HAVING M.IMPORTE+SUM(D.IMPORTE*D.SIGNO)>0.01 AND M.IMPORTE+SUM(D.IMPORTE*D.SIGNO)<M.IMPORTE-0.01
credit-clients: SELECT FIRST 3 CLAVE,SALDO FROM CLIE15 WHERE SALDO<-0.01
